summary: CRITICAL: Deliverable is incomplete. Spec requires TDD with bats-core test suite (not provided), local test harness that runs `act` and saves to `act-result.txt` (missing), and fixture files referenced in workflow (not shown). Script uses `set -euo pipefail` and proper error handling ✓, workflow has pinned action versions ✓, but jq cartesian/exclude/include logic lacks inline comments making it hard to maintain (lines ~50–70). Missing test fixtures means workflow can't actually run. Without tests, any refactoring risks silent breakage.
